hypothesis: A real Deribit options vol-surface/greeks gamma-hedged long-gamma (gamma-scalping) book is net-of-cost tradable for the underlying BTC/ETH perpetual on real, synchronized Deribit data.

protocol.title: Real Deribit options vol-surface / greeks gamma-hedged (long-gamma gamma-scalping) net-of-cost falsification
protocol.surface_to_greeks: per real 5m snapshot & chosen expiry/strike: IV backed out of real mark (implied_volatility(mark*spot, spot, K, 0, T, type)); delta/gamma from black_scholes_greeks at that IV (intrinsic-delta fallback if IV fails)
protocol.cost_model: net-of-cost: hedge turnover HEDGE_FEE_BPS on |Δhedge|*S; long option pays half real bid/ask at entry (ask) and exit (bid)
protocol.option_spread: half real bid/ask paid at entry and exit (long options pay the ask)
protocol.pnl: gross_k = +(dOptionUSD_k) + hedge_k*dS_k (long option, hedge=-position_delta); ret_k = (gross_k - cost_k)/S_k; decision at bar k -> outcome over [k,k+1] (causal)
protocol.gamma_attribution: diagnostic: realized gamma capture = sum 0.5*Gamma_usd_k*(dS_k)^2 vs total premium paid; gamma_capture_over_premium reported per config (not a pass criterion)
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on both BTC and ETH and at least one grid config, net-of-cost Sharpe > 0, no kill-switch breach (max-DD <= 0.20), permutation p < 0.05, bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled PBO < 0.5; else NO-GO.
